en.title: The Robot That Works 22-Hour Shifts: Inside Eternal.ag's Bid to Automate the Greenhouse
en.summary: German startup Eternal.ag deploys fully autonomous tomato-harvesting robots in Dutch greenhouses, raises €8M, and partners with seed giant Rijk Zwaan to solve Europe's agricultural labor crisis from the root up.

zh.title: 22 小时不停歇的温室机器人：德国创业公司 Eternal.ag 如何用全自主机器人解决欧洲农业用工荒
zh.summary: 德国农业科技公司 Eternal.ag 在荷兰温室部署全自主番茄采摘机器人，获 800 万欧元融资，并与种子巨头 Rijk Zwaan 合作，试图从作物基因层面推进温室自动化。
